name: Human
notes: Baseline humanoid species; broadly represented across the Galactic Union and Separatist factions. General Kael Durn (kael_durn) is Human. Primary polity: Galactic Union (multispecies).

naming_exemption.reason: Species name "Human" preserved verbatim from the cited species/civilization codex.

distribution: Broadly distributed baseline species; members span the Galactic Union, the Separatist Confederation, corporate PMCs, and unaligned frontier populations. NOT coextensive with any single polity.
identity_model_note: Species = a people (biology + broad cultural origin). Membership is not bounded by any single polity/faction; see member_polities (non-exhaustive) and distribution.
